<documents>
<document id="account-under-review">
AccountˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestrictedˆSometimesˆweˆneedˆtoˆreviewˆanˆaccount,ˆforˆexampleˆtoˆconfirmˆidentityˆdetails,ˆcheckˆunusualˆactivity,ˆorˆmeetˆlegalˆrequirements.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyouˆcanˆdoˆduringˆaˆreviewˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆdeposits.ˆDependingˆonˆtheˆreview,ˆyouˆmayˆnotˆbeˆableˆtoˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcash,ˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆorderˆaˆnewˆcard.ˆ##ˆWhatˆyou'llˆseeˆAˆbannerˆinˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆtheˆaccountˆisˆunderˆreviewˆorˆrestricted,ˆandˆwhatˆweˆneedˆfromˆyou,ˆifˆanything.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆItˆdependsˆonˆtheˆreason.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆdocuments,ˆsendingˆthemˆquicklyˆisˆtheˆbestˆwayˆtoˆspeedˆthingsˆup.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcan'tˆliftˆaˆreviewˆorˆrestriction,ˆandˆoftenˆcan'tˆshareˆtheˆreason.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆmessageˆtoˆtheˆVerificationˆteam,ˆwhoˆreplyˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆrestrictionsˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆbecauseˆofˆaˆnegativeˆbalance,ˆaddingˆmoneyˆliftsˆtheˆrestrictionˆonceˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="cushion-repayment">
RepayingˆCushionˆWhenˆCushionˆcoversˆaˆpurchase,ˆyourˆbalanceˆgoesˆbelowˆzero.ˆHere'sˆhowˆitˆgetsˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆ##ˆAutomaticˆrepaymentˆAnyˆmoneyˆthatˆcomesˆin,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆaˆtransferˆorˆaˆrefund,ˆgoesˆtowardˆtheˆnegativeˆbalanceˆfirst.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆdoˆanything.ˆ##ˆPayingˆitˆbackˆyourselfˆYouˆcanˆaddˆmoneyˆatˆanyˆtimeˆbyˆtransfer,ˆBrookPayˆfromˆanotherˆmember,ˆorˆaˆcashˆdepositˆatˆaˆstore.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆstaysˆnegativeˆ-ˆAfterˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspendedˆuntilˆyou'reˆbackˆatˆzeroˆandˆmeetˆtheˆdirectˆdepositˆrequirementˆagain.ˆ-ˆAfterˆ60ˆdays,ˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestricted.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆaddˆmoney,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆspendˆorˆsendˆitˆuntilˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆThereˆareˆnoˆfeesˆorˆinterestˆforˆusingˆCushion,ˆandˆnoneˆforˆrepayingˆlate.ˆTheˆonlyˆconsequencesˆareˆsuspensionˆandˆrestriction.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆcloseˆmyˆaccountˆwhileˆit'sˆnegative?ˆNo.ˆBringˆtheˆbalanceˆtoˆzeroˆfirst.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="products-joint-accounts">
Doˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆindividualˆaccountsˆonly.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆandˆyouˆcan'tˆaddˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆaˆsecondˆcardˆholder.ˆ##ˆSharingˆmoneyˆwithˆaˆpartnerˆEachˆofˆyouˆcanˆopenˆyourˆownˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆandˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆeachˆotherˆinstantlyˆwithˆBrookPay,ˆforˆfree.ˆ##ˆSharedˆgoalsˆSavingsˆPocketsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆaccountˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆshared.ˆYouˆcanˆeachˆsaveˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆgoalˆinˆyourˆownˆpockets.ˆ##ˆManagingˆanˆaccountˆforˆsomeoneˆelseˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆseeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney".ˆOtherwise,ˆweˆcanˆonlyˆtalkˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆholder.ˆ##ˆWillˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆWeˆdon'tˆhaveˆplansˆtoˆshareˆrightˆnow.ˆ##ˆCouplesˆandˆroommatesˆSplittingˆaˆbillˆisˆeasyˆwithˆBrookPay.ˆOneˆpersonˆpays,ˆandˆtheˆotherˆsendsˆtheirˆshareˆstraightˆfromˆtheˆapp.ˆBrookPayˆhasˆnoˆfeeˆandˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆfromˆaˆjointˆaccountˆelsewhereˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆaˆjointˆaccountˆyouˆholdˆatˆanotherˆbankˆasˆanˆexternalˆaccount,ˆasˆlongˆasˆyourˆnameˆisˆonˆit.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
